question: Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellow (Akademi Ratna) has been awarded to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jatin Goswami**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jatin Goswami

 
 
• A well-known veteran classical dancer from Assam is Jatin Goswami.
 
• In 1933, Jatin Goswami was born in Dergaon, Upper Assam.
 
• Jatin Goswami began his first lesson of Satriya dance at home with the help of his father.
 
• Later, he received expert gurus' instruction in dance and music on the Vaishnava Satras.
 
• In order to advance and expand the Satriya dancing style, he also founded a dance group.
 
• In 1962, the Kalaguru Bishnu Prasad Rabha and Roseswar Saikia Borbayan collaborated to form the dancing group known as Pragati Kala Parishad.
 
• Jatin Goswami has received numerous recommendations and titles.
 
• During the Khajuraho Dance Festival, Jatin Goswami was given the National Kalidas Samman, Madhya Pradesh's most prestigious cultural award, for 2017.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi

 
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi, the apex body in the field of performing arts in the country, was formed in 1953.
 
• It was set up for the preservation and promotion of the vast intangible heritage of India's diverse culture expressed in forms of music, dance, and drama.
 
• The management of the Akademi vests in its General Council.
 
• Ariyakudi Ramanuja Iyengar Karaikudi was the first to receive the Sahitya Natak Akademi award.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Puraskar is an award given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Academy was established on 31 May 1952 by a resolution of the Ministry of Human Resource development.
 
• The Akademi was officially inaugurated on 28 January 1953 by the first President of India Rajendra Prasad and PV Rajmannar was appointed as its first Chairman.
